# Mohamed Bennamane

> Robotics & AI engineering student at NHSAST (National Higher School of Autonomous Systems Technologies), Sidi Abdellah, Algiers, Algeria.

## About

Second-year preparatory engineering student at NHSAST. Active member of Team Delta, NHSAST's competitive robotics team preparing for the AST Festival with 7 competition entries. Co-manages Epsilite, a volunteer tutoring program. AI Manager at IEEE NHSAST. Event Manager at ASTCS. Co-authored a 200+ page Analysis II textbook with Dr. Zeglaoui. Sole author of the 219-page Analysis I Companion Book.

## Projects

- **NHSAST-Info**: Informational web platform about NHSAST with Arabic RTL support. 1,500+ visitors during specialty-choosing period. Solo project.
- **Epsilite**: Volunteer tutoring program and web platform for NHSAST students. 1,300+ visits during exam periods. Co-founded and co-managed.
- **Analysis II Textbook**: 200+ page calculus textbook co-authored with Dr. Zeglaoui. 23+ revision rounds. LaTeX with TikZ diagrams.
- **Analysis I Companion Book**: 219-page real analysis textbook, sole author. Blends rigorous theory with autonomous systems engineering applications.
- **POLYMAZE Robot**: ESP32-based autonomous maze-solving robot. Designed chassis in SolidWorks, 3D-printed, programmed in C++.
- **Team Delta (AST Festival)**: 7 robot entries — dog robot, sumo, rocket league, all-terrain rover, maze solver, line follower, innovation project.
- **Expand Trips Tracker**: Real-time school bus tracking via Telegram Live Location + Leaflet maps. Zero-cost deployment.

## Skills

ESP32, Arduino, Motor Control, Sensor Integration, Circuit Design, PID Control, C, C++, Python, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, 3D Printing, Chassis Design, LaTeX, TikZ, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, AI Agents, n8n Workflows

## Roles

- AI Manager at IEEE NHSAST
